title: 3‑BR Vacation Home in 30A Seagrove Beach with Communal Pool
meta_description: Aiden's Seagrove Serenity, a 3-BR, 3.5-bath 30A vacation home in Seagrove Beach with a communal pool and beach access. Accommodates 8 guests.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Aiden's Seagrove Serenity
normalized_matching_profile.description: Welcome to your bright beach retreat in beautiful Seagrove Beach! Aiden's Seagrove Serenity is a charming home and is the epitome of beachy bliss, with its vibrant blue exterior and inviting coastal vibes. With a thoughtfully designed bed layout, including a king bed, two queen beds, and two twin beds, this home comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests, making it perfect for families or groups.Step inside and be greeted by a bright and airy interior, adorned with coastal-inspired decor. The open-concept living space invites you to relax and unwind, whether you're lounging on the comfortable sofas or enjoying a delicious meal at the dining table. The fully equipped kitchen is a culinary haven, allowing you to prepare your favorite meals with ease. For the little ones, a baby Pack and Play is provided. Outside, the spacious front patio and upstairs screened-in porch provides the ideal setting for sipping your morning coffee before your fun day at the beach.When you're ready to hit the beach, a short stroll will take you to the pristine shores of Seagrove Beach. Sink your toes into the sugar-white sand, bask in the warm Florida sunshine, or take a refreshing dip in the crystal-clear waters of the Gulf of Mexico. After a day of beach fun, you can continue to unwind and make a splash at the nearby community pool, providing a perfect spot to relax and cool off before retreating back to the comfort of your home.Plus, don't forget to take advantage of the 3 bikes that come with the rental. They offer a delightful way to explore the picturesque surroundings, from charming pathways to hidden local gems. Whether you're seeking a leisurely ride or an adventurous excursion, these bikes add an extra layer of enjoyment to your vacation experience.With its prime location in Seagrove Beach, this vacation rental offers easy access to a plethora of dining, shopping, and entertainment options. Immerse yourself in the vibrant local scene, discover unique boutiques, and savor delicious coastal cuisine at nearby restaurants.Sleeping Arrangements:Bedroom 1: King bed.Bedroom 2: Queen bed.Bedroom 3: Queen bed.Sleeping nook: Twin-over-twin bunk beds.Beach Access:Head south on Sawgrass Ln and take Robert Ellis St all the way to the One Seagrove Place Public Beach Access!Distance: .3 miles | Time: 5 minutes walkingCottages at Seagrove:This small private community in Seagrove is tucked within the trees between 30A and Robert Ellis St. It has an incredible location that's close to Seaside, Watersound and Rosemary Beach, not to mention all of the shopping and dining options Seagrove is famous for. Within this neighborhood you'll also find an incredible community pool with plenty of seating and loungers.Your stay at Aiden's Seagrove Serenity comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 2 cars.An initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
